_comment: Real-documents harness: questions about the REAL docs pushed by the user (docs/: BCT circular 2019-08, Islamic banking internal guide, law 2016-48, Madkhal Sayrafa Islamiya) — all four are Arabic, so expected_lang is always 'ar'. Ground truth substrings were verified against the exact loader-normalized extracted text (see questions_real_verify.py output in the session). Categories: verbatim (AR question ~ document sentence), paraphrase (rephrased), cross-lingual (FR/EN question, translated to AR at query time), out-of-scope (no expected match).
